Hi, welcome to my corner of the web.

I’m Akif Mustafa, a biostatistician with a PhD in Biostatistics and Demography. My interests include adaptive designs in clinical trials and Bayesian methods. Here, I share ideas, explanations, and explorations in biostatistics, often with examples in R.

When I’m not working, I’m on my beautiful bike. If I’m not at my desk, chances are I’m lost somewhere in the Western Ghats - chasing winding roads in search of quiet corners and open air.
